COMMON QUESTIONS

Before we work together

Can I contact you before I know the exact specifications?

Yes. Send the product name, intended use or reference photos, and your estimated quantity. We can clarify the missing details during our discussions.

Can photos replace written specifications?

Photos help identify a product, but do not fully describe size, weight, processing or storage conditions. These details should be confirmed in writing for each order.
